integrity: The proof supplies explicit finite-to-asymptotic reduction, a modified-Bessel tail identity and uniform-integrability bounds. Reproducible numerical checks are supplementary and not an infinite proof. No claim of independent validation.
scientific_limitations: The sampling-size limit precedes the polygon-vertex limit. The fixed-polygon Poisson-corner distribution and the first-order \((\log m)/m\) estimate are established in earlier work. Simultaneous growth, irregular polygon arrays and complete priority verification are not asserted.
title: Gumbel transition and second-order Hausdorff error for randomly inscribed regular polygons
